ashen_cultist.desc: Ashen Cultist (elite, 1x): ash-grey hooded tunic, belted charcoal trousers, wide red sash, ember eyes. No plate.

magma_hound.desc: Magma hound (1.4x; gate foe at 2x): coal-black hound with glowing lava seams and ember eyes; pounces.

flame_elemental.desc: Flame elemental (1.5x): a spinning column of flame with a white-hot core and a dark little face.

fire_golem.desc: Fire golem (2x, slow): stacked obsidian chunks with glowing lava seams; wakes from the furnace walls.
